patch_description: Crossover of the current best (0.59: adaptive constant-velocity Kalman prefilter + fixed zero-phase SG smoother) with the 0.58 inspiration script (locally-adaptive multi-scale SG blending driven by local volatility). The new filter keeps the Kalman prefilter with robust 3σ innovation gating, then replaces the single fixed-scale SG stage with a volatility-driven soft blend of three zero-phase SG scales (narrow/medium/wide, weighted by Gaussian membership of local volatility at 20/50/80 percentiles). Wide scales activate where noise is high (fewer spurious slope reversals, better smoothness/noise reduction), narrow scales dominate where the signal is quiet (preserving responsiveness and genuine turning points). Additionally, a light slope-based lead compensation (using a low-pass filtered slope channel) recovers lag without amplifying noise. All stages are O(n) convolutions; end-aligned trim preserves the sliding-window output contract.
